# function: rds_snapshot_tenant_database

Builds the ARN for `rds` `snapshot-tenant-database`:

```
arn:${Partition}:rds:${Region}:${Account}:snapshot-tenant-database:${SnapshotName}:${TenantResourceId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:rds:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:snapshot-tenant-database:snapshot-name:tenant-resource-id
output "rds_snapshot_tenant_database" {
  value = provider::arn::rds_snapshot_tenant_database("snapshot-name", "tenant-resource-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
rds_snapshot_tenant_database(snapshot_name string, tenant_resource_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `snapshot_name` (String) Value for `${SnapshotName}` in the ARN template.
1. `tenant_resource_id` (String) Value for `${TenantResourceId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
